thread:
Sara (AE): quick heads-up — Greenline (enterprise) asked if we can guarantee EU-only data path for PII during a 6-week POC. They want: subprocessors list, certs for eu endpoints, confirmation on control-plane signalling, and a price delta for a small dedicated pool. Need ops/legal help pls
Jamal (SE): do they mean strict geo-lock (no egress) or just EU inference + metadata ok in US control plane?
Grace (Customer): clarifying — inference + storage must remain in EU. Control-plane signaling OK if it's metadata-only (no user content). BYOK preferred. Also need an onboarding checklist / ATO items.
Olivia (Legal): we can provide subprocessors + SOC2 + ISO attestation. But if they require control plane inside EU we escalate to Private. Can you confirm exact regions they want pinned?
Sara (AE): they mentioned EU-West & EU-Central as options, prefer eu-central.
Jamal (SE): hosted behavior: we route inference to nearest EU region; control plane (auth/signaling) currently lives in global control plane (US). For strict EU-only with no control-plane egress, recommend Dedicated or Private.
Nate (Infra Ops): confirm — Dedicated supports tenant pinning to eu-central-1 or eu-west-1 with data plane + KV cache kept in-region. Hosted = affinity, not hard lock. BYOK + HSM provisioning for Dedicated will take ~2–3 weeks lead time.
Olivia (Legal): I'll prep the DPA + subprocessors addendum. If they want subprocessors attestation with region-scoped list, we'll need to mark which subprocessors have EU data centers.
Jamal (SE): quick example endpoints for their engineers (dev-friendly):
```
# inference endpoint (EU pinned)
POST https://api.redwood-inference.eu/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
And control plane (metadata): `https://control.redwood-inference.com/signals` — note this is global.
Sara (AE): Grace — cost sensitivity is big for them. Jamal, can you give a back-of-envelope delta for a small dedicated pool (sustained QPS ~60)?
Jamal (SE): rough delta: dedicated small pool (4xA100 equiv) ~ +$11k–14k/mo on top of hosted baseline. If we enable quantization + batching might drop effective cost by ~25%. I'll follow up with a quoted number.
Nate (Infra Ops): ops note: for BYOK we need their KMS public key + contact for key custody. For HSM-backed BYOK add ~1 week procurement and ticketing. Also we support EU KMS replicas in `eu-west-1` and `eu-central-1`.
Grace (Customer): can you send a short checklist of what we need to provide (keys, IPs, contracts)? The procurement team wants a clear list.
Jamal (SE): checklist (drop into your procurement thread):
```
- Desired EU region to pin (eu-central-1 preferred)
- Expected sustained QPS / latency SLO
- BYOK: public key + KMS contact + rotation window
- Required subprocessors attestation (yes/no)
- Certs needed: SOC2, ISO27001 PDFs
- Timeline: preferred start date for 6-week POC
```
Sara (AE): Olivia — once you drop subproc list + DPA I can send to customer and request signature.
Olivia (Legal): will assemble today — expect subprocessors PDF + standard addendum by EOD.
region-bot: region activation notice — eu-central-1 HSM pool maintenance window scheduled 2024-11-02 03:00-04:00 UTC (no data-plane downtime expected)
Nate (Infra Ops): FYI — maintenance won't impact onboarding but call it out to the customer.
Grace (Customer): perfect, thanks all. I'll loop procurement and get keys/IPs over once I have the signed addendum. :thumbsup:
Sara (AE): thanks team — I'll coordinate next steps with Greenline, tagging this thread for the deal room.
